title: TEMPEST
tagline: A fine-dining concept organized around a single spatial gesture: a floor-to-ceiling glass cylinder containing a living storm of cloud and lightning at the center of the room.
description:
A fine-dining concept organized around a single spatial gesture: a floor-to-ceiling glass cylinder containing a living storm of cloud and lightning at the center of the room.

The concept studies how nature can act as the primary element of a fully enclosed interior. The storm is not a decorative feature but the organizing principle of the space: all zones are arranged around it, and the culinary experience - the presentation of dishes and the rhythm of service - is developed as its complement, extending the dramaturgy of the storm rather than competing with it.
meta_description: A fine-dining restaurant and bar concept built around a floor-to-ceiling glass cylinder holding a living storm of cloud and lightning, with all zones arranged around it.

lead.caption: Entrance. First glimpse of the storm; lightning reflects in the marble floor.

images.caption: Corridor. Rain runs across the glass ceiling; miniature storms glow inside brass lanterns.
Central bar. A round bar with a light wood front wraps the base of the glass cylinder.
Mezzanine. Dining at cloud level, almost inside the storm.
Glass-side booth. A candle, a glass of wine, and a full storm an arm's length away.
Open kitchen. Chefs at work behind a light wood counter, the storm beyond the glass.
